sn22.10:1.4: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekho hoti,
sn22.10:1.6: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn22.10:1.12: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ viññāṇasmiṃ anapekho hoti,
sn22.10:1.14: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotīti.
